title: Begin Your BIU Journey
subtitle: Share your details below and our Admissions Cell will contact you with course brochures, fee structures, and campus visit counseling.
thankYouMessage: Thank you for reaching out to Bareilly International University. Our counselors will contact you shortly.
defaultTemplate: Hello BIU Admissions Team, I would like to inquire about program eligibility, fee structure, and seat availability for the 2026-27 academic session.
